application_text:
To,
The Public Information Officer,
Pune Municipal Corporation, Public Works Department (Road Maintenance Division)
(Best guess — please confirm the correct Public Information Officer and mailing address before submitting.)

Subject: Request for information under the Right to Information Act, 2005

Sir/Madam,

I, Ramesh Kulkarni, residing at 12, Shivaji Nagar, Kothrud, am a citizen of India. I hereby request the following information concerning Pune for the period the last 6 months, under Section 6(1) of the Right to Information Act, 2005.

This application is made in writing under Section 6(1) of the Right to Information Act, 2005, and is accompanied by the prescribed application fee.

As per Section 7(1) of the Act, I request that the above information be furnished within thirty days of receipt of this application.

Particulars of information sought:

1. Copy of the road‑repair complaint filed with the Pune Municipal Corporation (including date and reference number) for the last 6 months
2. Inspection reports or work orders issued for the concerned road in Pune during the last 6 months
3. All correspondence (letters, emails, SMS) sent by the Pune Municipal Corporation regarding the complaint
4. Name, designation and contact details of the officer(s) responsible for processing the complaint
5. Status or action‑taken report for the complaint as of the current date

I declare that I am a citizen of India and that the information sought does not, to the best of my knowledge, fall under any of the exemptions in the Act.

Yours faithfully,

_________________________
Ramesh Kulkarni
Phone: 9876543210
Date: 21 August 2026
